title: SHA-1 hash used for image cache filename without usedforsecurity=False
detail: hash_image_id() at line 52 calls hashlib.sha1(image_id.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest() to derive the cache filename from an image UUID. SHA-1 is a deprecated algorithm; while this is not a password hash, omitting usedforsecurity=False precludes FIPS-compliant deployments and signals that the call was not deliberately audited for security context. The same pattern appears at line 317 where a file-path fingerprint is derived via hashlib.sha1().

title: SHA-1 hash used for image path fingerprint without usedforsecurity=False
detail: At line 317-318, hashlib.sha1(encodeutils.safe_encode(img)).hexdigest() computes a fingerprint of an image file path string for cache lookup. SHA-1 is deprecated; the absence of usedforsecurity=False makes this call incompatible with FIPS mode and marks it as an unaudited security-relevant hash. The same pattern appears at line 52.
